LOG1_DD: As co-founder and CTO of 1.5°C, I lead the computer vision, satellite imagery, and fire-risk models — with the engineering, ML, and environmental science team that builds them with me.
LOG2_DD: Nine AI agents in production on Hermes, the open-source agent runtime, on our own servers. One central orchestrator and one engineering agent for PRs and infrastructure; the other seven work inside sales, CS, support, marketing, projects, fire alerts, and leadership, each with a human owner. Every PR the agent writes is reviewed and merged by a person.
LOG_DELEGATION_DD: Ran Customer Success, Marketing, Support, and HR at various points — none of it engineering. Fixed what was broken, then handed each off once there was a real owner to take it.
LOG3_DD: Contributor since 2022 to ForeFire, CNRS's open-source wildfire simulator, maintainer since 2025, and co-author on its JOSS paper — reviewing and merging PRs, cutting releases, Dockerization, CI/CD, documentation.
LOG4_DD: Open to CTO or senior technical leadership roles — in climate, govtech, or agentic systems, where the hard part isn't the model but putting it inside an operation where being wrong is expensive.
